== Introduction ==
Large Scottish QW LAN from June 1997.

Ettu dominated the 1on1 tournament, not losing a map.

[[Kage]] upset [[Lord Storm]] (who was third seed) in the quarterfinals. But apart from that, don't recall any of the other results.

== Results ==
* 1st - [[Ettu]]
* 2nd - [[Cenobite]]
* 3rd (tie) - [[Kage]]
* 5th (tie) - [[Lord Storm]]
